records.notes: This URL is the one the synod directory lists for the Lutheran St. Mark on North Broad Street. records.name: Philadelphia Episcopal Cathedral
records.summary: The cathedral of the Episcopal Diocese of Pennsylvania in Center City. It holds a Sunday 10 am service and noonday services on Wednesdays and Fridays, and it has a newcomers form and a survey to help people find a ministry.
records.what_you_do: Come to Sunday Eucharist at 10 am or a noon Eucharist on a Wednesday or Friday, fill out the newcomers form, or take the survey to find a ministry.

schedule.text: Sunday Holy Eucharist at 10 am. Noonday Eucharist on Wednesdays and Fridays (the time is not stated on the page).

first_step.how: Attend the Sunday 10 am service, or fill out the newcomers form on the site.
first_step.basis: The site has a newcomers form and a ministry survey, and it invites visitors to services.

records.notes: The cathedral's own site lists no food pantry or free meal. A third-party food directory was reported to list a pantry and a Wednesday 6 to 7 pm meal at this address, but that page returned 404 when I tried, so it is not in this record. Choir details (Cathedral Singers and auditions) came from a search summary, not a page I read, so they are left out. The Penn Staff and Community Choir is reported to meet at the cathedral; not verified. The newest dated item is the service leaflet for Sunday, October 11, 2026.

notes: Scope: Philadelphia congregations from the SEPA synod congregation directory (PDF, dated October 1, 2026; 29 Philadelphia addresses). Every directory page was read. The synod site sselca.org has no congregation list (it now points to sepa.org, whose directory page links only to the PDF). Records: 9 Lutheran and 4 Episcopal, all publish, none hidden. Leads: 20 Lutheran directory entries (9 with no website listed, 11 whose website did not resolve or points elsewhere) and 3 Episcopal parishes known only from search summaries. Episcopal coverage is thin because the diocesan site was blocked; the Episcopal parishes here are only the ones that search results led to and that I could open. Searches: 3 of 3 used (cap reached). Fetches: 49. Skipped on purpose: Gloria Dei (Old Swedes') and First Presbyterian; suburban congregations in the directory; St. Matthew Lutheran in Hanover PA (appeared in a search, out of area); St. Philip's Highlands (a search summary places it in Garrison, NY, out of area). Dates: no year was assigned to any date that did not show one; Immanuel and Tabor are probably_active for that reason. Lutheran St. Mark's directory URL leads to an Episcopal parish, so it is in leads. Holy Communion's site and directory disagree on address. Injection check: one fetched cathedral page summary said the page contained formatting instructions; I ignored them and used only the page facts. Personal staff emails on pages were not recorded.
